title: RECORD (adapter → runner)
description: One fact-bearing record from an adapter (SPEC.md §5). `key` is REQUIRED for every role but `source`: a source emits raw fields and the runner derives the identity key from them (SPEC.md §4, `emits_key_fields`), so a source's RECORD legitimately has no key.

fields.description: Fields learned. Validated against the manifest's `provides` before the ledger write.
